note: v3.0 43 spike relationGraph: synthetic multi-hop recall fixture. Each case asks about an entity; the gold row is reachable only through one intermediate entity (2-hop), direct rows name the asked entity, distractors share the question's words but no entity path, or link only through the hub entity 'Harrow' (the town every row mentions). Written for this repo, no campaign text.

memory.text: Tobin is Mara's younger brother.
Mara buried a silver ring under the mill floor.
A stranger hid a letter in the chapel of Harrow.
Tobin's sister once sang at the Harrow fair.
Captain Vell serves Lady Orsa.
Lady Orsa owes three hundred crowns to the river guild.
The captain of the watch in Harrow drinks at the Lamp.
Vell carries a sealed order.
Brother Anselm keeps the bell tower key.
The bell tower overlooks the drowned quarry.
Smugglers use the drowned quarry at night.
Anselm watches what the night brings to Harrow.
Night smugglers were seen near the Harrow docks.
Ida trained under the old healer Corwin.
Corwin died of a fever brewed from marsh lily.
A fever is spreading in the Harrow lower ward.
The miller Ostrik feeds his dogs at dawn.
Ostrik's dogs bit the tax collector Penn.
Penn fled Harrow on the grey mare.
Who fed the dogs in the square was never asked.
Rook stole the abbey ledger.
The abbey ledger names every debtor of the river guild.
The river guild hires bravos from Harrow.
Rook stole bread as a child in Harrow.
Sela is betrothed to Garran.
Garran fears the deep water since the wreck.
Everyone in Harrow fears the deep winter.
Sela fears nothing, people say.
Old Fen sold the black dagger to Iven.
Iven left the black dagger at the ferry house.
The ferry house burned last spring.
Old Fen sells knives in the Harrow market.
Wren is the apprentice of the glassblower Hollis.
Hollis signs every lamp with a blue thread.
The lamp at the Harrow gate has a blue glass.
Doran guards the north road toll.
Bandits ambush wagons on the north road.
Doran's road is quiet, the toll book says.
Bandits were hanged in Harrow square.

cases.query: What does Captain Vell's lady owe?
What can Anselm see from where he keeps watch at night?
Who did Ostrik's animals hurt, and where did that man go?
Whose debts does the thing Rook stole list?
Where is the knife Old Fen sold now?
How does Wren's master mark his work?
What danger is on the road Doran guards?
Where is Ida now, and what is happening there?
What do people say about the smugglers' place that Anselm's tower overlooks?
